zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT z.zonecode AS a_code, z.zonename AS a_name, SUM(s.female) AS r3, SUM(s.female1) AS r2, SUM(s.female2) AS r1, SUM(s.male) AS t3, SUM(s.male1) AS t2, SUM(s.male2) AS t1, SUM(s.total) AS p3, SUM(s.total1) AS p2, SUM(s.total2) AS p1 FROM s_midyearpopmoph as s INNER join cchangwat as c on substr(s.areacode, 1, 2) = c.changwatcode INNER join czone as z on c.zonecode = z.zonecode WHERE ({{ZONE_CODE}} IN (c.zonecode, 'ALL')) AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} GROUP BY z.zonecode, z.zonename ORDER BY z.zonecode

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name ,  SUM(target) as target ,SUM(result) as result ,SUM(result1) as result1 ,SUM(result2) as result2 ,SUM(result3) as result3  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}})  GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name  ORDER BY h.zone_code

provider.label: หน่วยบริการ
provider.query: SELECT h.hoscode as a_code ,concat(h.hoscode,':',h.hosname) as a_name ,  SUM(target) as target ,SUM(result) as result ,SUM(result1) as result1 ,SUM(result2) as result2 ,SUM(result3) as result3  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE h.hdc_regist=1 AND (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}})  GROUP BY h.hoscode,concat(h.hoscode  ORDER BY h.hoscode

cup.label: เครือข่ายบริการ
cup.query: SELECT m.hmain as a_code ,concat('CUP:',m.hmainname) as a_name ,  SUM(target) as target ,SUM(result) as result ,SUM(result1) as result1 ,SUM(result2) as result2 ,SUM(result3) as result3  FROM cmastercup as m LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON m.hsub=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} JOIN chospital_regis as h ON h.hoscode = m.hospcode5 LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}})  GROUP BY m.hmain,concat('CUP:'  ORDER BY m.hmain

moo.label: หมู่
moo.query: SELECT v.villagecodefull as a_code, concat('หมู่ ', v.villagecode) as a_name, SUM(female) AS r3, SUM(female1) AS r2, SUM(female2) AS r1, SUM(male) AS t3, SUM(male1) AS t2, SUM(male2) AS t1, SUM(total) AS p3, SUM(total1) AS p2, SUM(total2) AS p1 FROM s_midyearpopmoph as s join cvillage as v on s.areacode = v.villagecodefull join ctambon as t on substr(s.areacode, 1, 6) = t.tamboncodefull left join campur as a on a.ampurcodefull = t.ampurcode left join cchangwat as c on c.changwatcode = a.changwatcode left join czone as z on c.zonecode = z.zonecode WHERE ( c.zonecode = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( c.changwatcode = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( a.ampurcodefull = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( t.tamboncodefull = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} GROUP BY v.villagecodefull, v.villagecode ORDER BY v.villagecodefull

tambon.label: ตำบล
tambon.query: SELECT t.tamboncodefull as a_code, t.tambonname as a_name, SUM(female) AS r3, SUM(female1) AS r2, SUM(female2) AS r1, SUM(male) AS t3, SUM(male1) AS t2, SUM(male2) AS t1, SUM(total) AS p3, SUM(total1) AS p2, SUM(total2) AS p1 FROM s_midyearpopmoph as s join cvillage as v on s.areacode = v.villagecodefull join ctambon as t on substr(s.areacode, 1, 6) = t.tamboncodefull left join campur as a on a.ampurcodefull = t.ampurcode left join cchangwat as c on c.changwatcode = a.changwatcode left join czone as z on c.zonecode = z.zonecode WHERE ( c.zonecode = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( c.changwatcode = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( a.ampurcodefull = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( t.tamboncodefull = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} GROUP BY t.tamboncodefull, t.tambonname ORDER BY t.tamboncodefull

ampur.label: อำเภอ
ampur.query: SELECT a.ampurcodefull as a_code, a.ampurname as a_name, SUM(female) AS r3, SUM(female1) AS r2, SUM(female2) AS r1, SUM(male) AS t3, SUM(male1) AS t2, SUM(male2) AS t1, SUM(total) AS p3, SUM(total1) AS p2, SUM(total2) AS p1 FROM s_midyearpopmoph as s join ctambon as t on substr(s.areacode, 1, 6) = t.tamboncodefull left join campur as a on a.ampurcodefull = t.ampurcode left join cchangwat as c on c.changwatcode = a.changwatcode left join czone as z on c.zonecode = z.zonecode WHERE ( c.zonecode = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( c.changwatcode = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( a.ampurcodefull = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( t.tamboncodefull = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} GROUP BY a.ampurcodefull, a.ampurname ORDER BY a.ampurcodefull

province.label: จังหวัด
province.query: SELECT c.changwatcode as a_code, c.changwatname as a_name, SUM(female) AS r3, SUM(female1) AS r2, SUM(female2) AS r1, SUM(male) AS t3, SUM(male1) AS t2, SUM(male2) AS t1, SUM(total) AS p3, SUM(total1) AS p2, SUM(total2) AS p1 FROM s_midyearpopmoph as s join ctambon as t on substr(s.areacode, 1, 6) = t.tamboncodefull left join campur as a on a.ampurcodefull = t.ampurcode left join cchangwat as c on c.changwatcode = a.changwatcode left join czone as z on c.zonecode = z.zonecode WHERE ( c.zonecode = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( c.changwatcode = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( a.ampurcodefull = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( t.tamboncodefull = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} GROUP BY c.changwatcode, c.changwatname ORDER BY c.changwatcode
